claude_only.name: Which alternate identifiers resolve to the same artifact across registries, package formats and BOM documents?
Does the identifier denote the abstract model family, a released version, or one immutable serialized snapshot?
How are identifier collisions, repository renames and namespace transfers detected and reconciled?
What versioning scheme applies, and which change classes trigger a major, minor or patch increment?
Which immutable revision or content digest pins the exact bytes referenced by a given version label?
Which artifact version supersedes or is superseded by this one, and is the predecessor still resolvable?
Which mutable pointers may reference this artifact, and how is pointer drift detected and controlled?
When was this version released, and how does release time differ from the time it was ingested into the registry of record?
What type of model is this by architecture family, specific architecture and parameter count?
Which task or pipeline classification describes the artifact's primary intended function?
What application domain and level of decision autonomy is the artifact characterised for?
Which controlled vocabulary governs each classification value, and who may extend it?
Does a free and open-source release exempt this artifact from specific documentation duties, and on what evidence?
In which jurisdictions is the artifact placed on the market or put into service, and which regimes therefore apply?
Which legal entity holds provider obligations, and when does that role transfer to a downstream modifier?
Which training or build run produced this artifact, and is that run reference resolvable today?
Which build platform issued the provenance attestation, and what trust level does its builder identity carry?
What external parameters, internal parameters and resolved dependencies were recorded for the producing run?
Can the artifact be re-derived from the recorded inputs, and which nondeterminism sources are documented?
What compute resources and wall-clock training time were consumed to produce the artifact?
Which base model or models is this artifact derived from, and by which derivation operation?
How deep is the derivation chain, and is every upstream artifact individually identifiable?
If the artifact is a merge, what are the constituent models and the combination method or weights?
Which upstream licence terms, use restrictions or attribution duties propagate to this artifact?
What datasets, of what type and provenance, and with what curation methodology, underlie training, validation and testing?
Is a sufficiently detailed public summary of training content required, and where is the current version published?
Does the training corpus contain sensitive or personal information, and under what lawful basis was it processed?
How were data partitioned into training, validation and test splits, and was contamination between them assessed?
Is the artifact signed, by which identity, and under which signing method?
Which files are covered by the signed manifest, and how are uncovered files treated at load time?
Is the signing event recorded in an append-only log whose inclusion proof a verifier can check?
What verification outcome is required before the artifact may be promoted, distributed or served?
Does a machine-readable bill of materials enumerate the artifact's model, data and software components?
Which BOM format and version is authoritative, and how are parallel formats kept consistent?
Which third-party components introduce known vulnerabilities or unsafe deserialisation paths?
When is the BOM regenerated, and how is it bound to a specific artifact revision?
In which serialization format are the weights stored, and at which version of that format?
What numeric precision or quantization scheme do the stored tensors use, and against which reference precision?
Does the format permit arbitrary code execution on load, and what mitigation is enforced?
How is the artifact sharded across files, and how is shard completeness verified before use?
Which components are mandatory for the artifact to be loadable, and which are optional accompaniments?
What role does each packaged component play — weights, weight configuration, code, documentation or dataset?
How is the human-readable model card bound to the exact artifact revision it describes?
Into which packaging or registry envelope is the component set published?
What is the declared schema of the artifact's inputs, outputs and inference parameters?
What maximum input size, context window or sequence limits constrain a valid call?
How is a caller's payload validated against the declared signature before inference runs?
Which operator set, graph IR version or tokenizer vocabulary must a runtime support to execute the artifact?
Which runtime, library and flavor combinations can load and execute this artifact?
What accelerator, memory and driver minimums are required for inference at the declared precision?
Which exact dependency versions were used at production time, and which are certified for serving?
What happens when the artifact runs outside its certified environment, and is that configuration blocked or only flagged?
Which metrics, on which datasets and splits, are reported for this artifact revision?
Who produced each reported result, under which protocol, and is it independently reproducible?
What decision thresholds are attached to each metric for promotion, rejection or rollback?
As of when was each result measured, and does it still apply to the current revision?
What are the intended tasks, intended users and in-scope use cases for this artifact?
Which technical limitations and performance trade-offs are known and documented?
What explainability or interpretability information accompanies the artifact?
What safety risk assessment has been performed on the artifact, and which residual risks remain?
What internal or external adversarial testing was conducted, by whom, and with what results?
Which mitigations are bound to the artifact itself rather than to the system around it?
Which events trigger re-assessment of the artifact's safety profile?
Which demographic, environmental and instrumentation factors are relevant to disaggregated evaluation of this artifact?
How does performance vary across the relevant factor groups and their intersections?
What bias detection and mitigation measures were applied to the data and to the model?
Who accepts that fairness evidence is sufficient for the intended deployment context?
How much energy was consumed for training, for fine-tuning and per unit of inference?
What greenhouse-gas equivalent is reported, and under which accounting method and grid assumptions?
Are the reported figures measured or estimated, and what uncertainty is stated?
Which time window and which hardware fleet do the reported figures cover?
Which licence governs the weights, and is it expressed as a resolvable standard identifier or a custom document?
Do weights, code, tokenizer and documentation carry different licences?
Which field-of-use, redistribution or derivative restrictions does the licence impose?
What attribution or notice must a downstream user reproduce?
Is there a documented policy for complying with copyright law, and where is it maintained?
How were machine-readable rights reservations detected and honoured during data acquisition?
What process handles third-party rights claims raised against the artifact after release?
Who bears liability for rights infringement arising from the artifact or its outputs?
Through which channels is the artifact distributed, and which one is authoritative?
Is the release open-weights, gated, API-only or internal-only?
How is a mirrored or cached copy proven equivalent to the authoritative release?
What is the procedure for withdrawing a released artifact from each channel?
What is the default access rule for the artifact's weights, and who may grant exceptions?
Which conditions gate access, and how is satisfaction of each condition evidenced?
Is the artifact subject to export control or sanctions screening, and under which classification?
Where may the weights be stored and processed, and which residency constraints apply?
Which lifecycle states can this artifact occupy, and which state is it in now?
Who is authorised to approve each state transition, and against which gate criteria?
When did each state transition occur, and when was each transition recorded?
Under what conditions may a promotion be rolled back, and what happens to artifacts that depend on it?
What marks this artifact deprecated, and which replacement is announced to consumers?
How long must the artifact and its technical documentation be retained, and on what legal or contractual basis?
What exactly is deleted at end of life — weights, derivatives, caches, mirrors, logs — and what must be preserved?
What evidence proves deletion or destruction, and who attests to it?
Which downstream systems and derived artifacts must be notified before deletion proceeds?
Which organisational unit owns this artifact, and which named role stewards it day to day?
How are producing, approving and operating roles separated for this artifact?
What happens to ownership when the responsible team is reorganised or the artifact is transferred externally?
Which contact point handles questions, defect reports and rights claims about the artifact?
Which documentation items must exist for this artifact, and which are mandatory versus recommended?
How is documentation kept up to date as the artifact changes, and when was each item last revised?
What information must be handed to downstream integrators so they can meet their own obligations?
Which parts may be redacted to protect trade secrets, and what minimum must still be disclosed?
Who may request the full documentation set, and within what response time?
Which AI systems, endpoints or products currently reference this artifact revision?
Which operational events are attributed back to this artifact rather than to the surrounding system?
How do downstream observations trigger re-evaluation, patching or withdrawal of the artifact?
How is a deployment's claimed artifact revision verified against the artifact of record?

grok_only.name: Which governed global identifiers or IRIs are bound to the same artifact for supply-chain interchange?
How are master-system, global, and Dimension-assigned identifiers crosswalked so they denote one artifact?
What version or revision scheme is used, and which value is immutable for this payload?
When was this version released or built, as distinct from when the Dimension ingested the record?
Does a declared successor or new_version replace this artifact for discovery?
What primary task or pipeline is this artifact intended to perform?
Which library and typeOfModel values describe how the artifact is loaded and what kind of model it is?
Is this artifact a foundation model readily adaptable to a wide range of tasks?
Into what types of AI systems is this model intended to be integrated?
Which serialization formats carry this artifact's parameters and graph?
Which files or blobs are members of this artifact version, and how are they composed?
What is the artifact size and media type of each payload member?
Which cryptographic hashes were computed over which payload members, and with which algorithms?
Is the artifact cryptographically signed, and by which key or identity?
What verification method and last-verified result exist for this version?
What named inputs, types, and shapes must be supplied to load or score this artifact?
What named outputs, types, and shapes does the artifact emit?
If an ONNX projection exists, which opset and domain versions does it require?
What architecture family and design specifications describe this artifact?
How many parameters does the artifact contain, and in which unit?
What overall learning approach was used to construct the model?
Which base model artifacts does this version derive from?
What kind of derivation relates this artifact to its bases?
If quantized or adapted, which scheme and which tensors are additional versus inherited?
Which training or fine-tuning run produced this artifact version?
Which training, validation, and test datasets are declared for this artifact?
Which hyperparameters and training-process facts are copied onto this artifact?
What intended uses and user groups are documented for this artifact?
What technical, performance, and knowledge limitations are documented?
Is Annex XI technical documentation drawn up, current, and available to the AI Office on request?
What Annex XII information is available to downstream AI-system providers who will integrate this model?
Does the free and open-source exemption apply, and are weights, architecture, and usage information public?
Which performance metrics, values, and evaluation contexts are attached to this version?
What metric decision thresholds, if any, are declared for operating the artifact?
Who produced each attached result, and is it self-reported or independently verified?
What licence is declared and, where SPDX applies, what licence is concluded for this artifact?
What acceptable-use policy applies to distribution and integration of this artifact?
What copyright and text-and-data-mining reservation policy applies to training content for this GPAI artifact?
Does this artifact use sensitive personal information, and with what presence value?
What safety-risk assessment, if any, is recorded on the package?
What energy consumption and training compute are known or estimated for this artifact?
Which mutable aliases currently point at this version, and for which environments?
What lifecycle stage or status tags apply, and are deprecated stage names still in use?
When, if at all, was this version archived, revoked, or given a valid-until time?
Who is the accountable owner and who supplied this artifact version?
Where is the canonical payload stored, and what is the download location?
Who may read, download, or modify this artifact, and which exceptions exist for authorities?
What retention schedule applies, and has the payload or the record been deleted or tombstoned?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
